Alex: Quick check — vendor confirmed Wave 2 H100 shipment arrives Wed AM (manifest attached). Can infra confirm rack space + PDUs for 4 nodes?
Maya: Rack spots 12-15 reserved in Row C. PDUs are on-site but rack 13 needs an upgraded PDU (30A).
Sanjay: I'll schedule the electrician for Tue 9–11. ETA ~2 hrs to swap the PDU. @Maya can you drop the PDU model and cable type?
Maya: PDU: APC AP8855 (30A). Power cords: IEC-309 to C19. Also extra PDUs in crate labeled "power-wave2" in staging.
Alex: Noted. ops-bot: PO status?
ops-bot: PO#7890 updated -> 4x H100 nodes, ETA 3 days, tracking: https://shipper.example/track/7890
Jen: Heads up — capacity reservation `2024-Q3-2` needs assignment to Dedicated Sku `h100-8g`. @Liam can you own SKU mapping + runtime image ops?
Liam: I got it. Will update the SKU mapping sheet and kick off image bake.
Sanjay: Onboarding checklist (quick):
- VLAN 42 assigned
- Racking script queued (`/scripts/rack.sh --wave2`)
- BMC creds pending rotation
Maya: BMC creds are in the vault under `proc-wave2`. Tag `proc-wave2` and `infra-access`. Jen, confirm you have vault access.
Jen: I can access the vault. Will rotate BMC creds post-smoke tests.
Alex: Runtime team — any blockers for image bake or kernel bump?
Liam: Kernel bump to 5.15 passed unit tests on canary, but saw NVLink warnings on canary-2. I'll open a PR to pin driver versions and add a short test.
Maya: Can we leave canary-1 soaking overnight once racked? Prefer to run one full overnight job.
Sanjay: Yes, canary-1 stays up. I'll hold off broader rollout until soak complete.
Liam: PR here: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/912 — requesting review from @Alex and @Jen.
Alex: Reviewing now, should be quick.
deploy-bot: smoke-run started on canary-1 at 2024-05-14T03:12Z
Jen: Smoke looks green on CPU/infra checks; only nvlink warnings reported.
Sanjay: Electrician booked for Tue 10:30 local.
Alex: New milestone: rack-acceptance + smoke tests by Thu EOD. If anyone sees a slip, post an update here and tag @eng-infra.
Maya: Copy — will post PDU photos after install.
Liam: Will follow up with runtime soak logs in ~6h.
Alex: Thanks all — keep async updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
